BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Health & Long Term Care.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to midwife fees; amending RCW 18.50.050 and 18.50.102; adding a new section to chapter 18.50 RCW; and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature finds that midwives provide high value care. The legislature intends to ensure the number of practicing midwives continues to grow, and that no person is prevented from entering the practice of midwifery due to the cost of licensure.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 18.50 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Initial application fees and renewal fees for licensure as a midwife must be set by the secretary as provided in RCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280 and must not exceed five hundred twenty-five dollars annually per license.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. RCW 18.50.050 and 1996 c 191 s 24 are each amended to read as follows:Compliance with secretary's determination.
BillSection.P: Applicants shall comply with administrative procedures, administrative requirements, and fees determined by the secretary as provided by RCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280 section 2 of this act.

CrossRefNote.NoteP: Limitation on increases in midwifery fees: RCW 43.24.086.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 4. RCW 18.50.102 and 2014 c 187 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:License renewal.
BillSection.P: (1) A licensed midwife must renew his or her license according to the following requirements:
(a) Completion of a minimum of thirty hours of continuing education, approved by the secretary, every three years;
(b) Proof of participation in a Washington state coordinated quality improvement program as detailed in rule;
(c) Proof of participation in data submission on perinatal outcomes to a national or state research organization, as detailed in rule; and
(d) Fees determined by the secretary as provided in RCW 43.70.250 and 43.70.280 section 2 of this act.
(2) The secretary shall write rules regarding the renewal requirements and the department's process for verification of the third-party data submission.

AnnNote.NoteP: Effective date—1981 c 53: See note following RCW 18.50.005.

CrossRefNote.NoteP: Limitation on increases in midwifery fees: RCW 43.24.086.
